decision: retain candidate with explicitly accepted plain-large RSS regression
review_trigger: docs/GOAL.md flags >5% adverse change for review rather than automatic rejection
reason: All four synthetic open/traversal corpora show material 17–28% median improvements and lower whole-child allocation counts on both profiled large corpora. Fixed transient storage and unchanged semantic/resource boundaries were independently reviewed. The ~2 MiB uninstrumented RSS cost remains a limitation, not dismissed by profiler measurements.
remaining_uncertainty: Exact allocator/working-set cause of RSS increase is unproven; broader CRUD/provider and host variability coverage remains open.
correctness_review: No blocking correctness or resource-boundary finding; full checked iterator and ordered error fallback retained. Eight private differential tests and four public integration tests supplement existing suite.
initial_test_failure: A redundant private-test std::fmt::Write import failed unused-import lint; removed before successful final suite, without changing timed production source.
scope: No public API, dependency, ownership, configured-budget, concurrency or unsafe changes; no strict-registry promotion
